chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fudayla ibn Ayyub, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Take your adornment at every Masjid.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'During the two Eids and Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic command 'Take your adornment at every Masjid' specifically refer to according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the general command to 'take your adornment' is specifically contextualized to the two Eid festivals and Friday prayers, highlighting the Shia emphasis on outward dignity and preparation for communal worship. This interpretation underscores the ritual significance of physical cleanliness and attire as acts of reverence during the most prominent weekly and annual congregational gatherings in Islamic practice.
